comment: The supervisor lifecycle finite state machine. This file IS the supervisor's state. The agent reads current_state, finds the single legal transition whose `from` equals it, runs ONLY that transition's command, and the command advances current_state by rewriting this file. Guards are GIT predicates (resolved by hooks/gate-commit.sh against the real working tree), never prose, so they cannot be talked past. One concept, one home: the transition table lives ONCE here and is cited by instructions/10-state-machine.md and every command.

states.name: init
states.description: Empty project. No charter exists yet. The only legal act is to draft a charter.

states.name: charter_drafted
states.description: A charter document exists at init/charter/charter.md but is not yet ratified by the human. It may be revised (re-draft) or ratified.

states.name: charter_ratified
states.description: The human has ratified the charter. The scope is frozen. The next act is to decompose the product into work items.

states.name: product_decomposed
states.description: The product is decomposed into a set of work items under init/product/. Open decisions (unruled forks) may now be raised.

states.name: decisions_open
states.description: At least one open decision (an unruled fork) exists under init/decisions/open/. Forks must all be ruled before planning.

states.name: decisions_ruled
states.description: Every open decision has been ruled and moved to init/decisions/ruled/. No fork remains open. Planning may begin.

states.name: planned
states.description: An implementation plan exists at init/plan/plan.md binding work items to ordered work packages. Building may begin.

states.name: building
states.description: Work packages are being executed. The supervisor tracks progress until every package is complete.

states.name: done
states.description: Every planned work package is complete. The lifecycle is finished.

guard.description: The charter is not already ratified (no init/charter/.ratified marker tracked in git).
A drafted charter exists in git at init/charter/charter.md.
The charter is not yet ratified (the early product-inquiry phase): no init/charter/.ratified marker tracked in git.
A product questionnaire exists under init/product/questionnaire/ (a question to answer).
The charter is ratified (init/charter/.ratified is tracked in git).
At least one work item exists under init/product/ (the product has been decomposed).

to_when.description: No open decision remains after this ruling.
At least one open decision still remains.

guard.description: At least one open decision exists under init/decisions/open/ to rule.
No open decision remains under init/decisions/open/ (every fork is ruled). This is the unforgeable 'no open forks' guard — it reads `git ls-files init/decisions/open/` and fails if non-empty.

to_when.description: No incomplete work item remains; every package is complete.
At least one incomplete work item remains; keep building.

guard.description: An implementation plan exists at init/plan/plan.md.
